source: Choose Chicago 2026 holiday lights guide; NBC Chicago (Nov 15, 2026)

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Chicago this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: ZooLights
items.blurb: Millions of lights across the zoo with light shows, a Ferris wheel and Santa visits.
items.blurbEs: Millones de luces en el zoológico, con espectáculos de luces, rueda de la fortuna y visitas de Santa.

items.name: City of Chicago Christmas Tree
items.blurb: The city's tree on Michigan Avenue, lit with music and fireworks.
items.blurbEs: El árbol de la ciudad en Michigan Avenue, encendido con música y fuegos artificiales.

items.name: Lightscape
items.blurb: A mile-long night trail of light, color and sound installations by artists from around the world.
items.blurbEs: Un recorrido nocturno de una milla con instalaciones de luz, color y sonido.

items.name: Illumination: Tree Lights
items.blurb: Nature-inspired light installations along a one-mile path, with fire pits and a model train. Some dog-friendly nights.
items.blurbEs: Instalaciones de luz inspiradas en la naturaleza en un sendero de una milla, con fogatas y un tren a escala.

items.name: Holiday Magic
items.blurb: More than 3.5 million lights, glowing tunnels, a light maze and a carousel.
items.blurbEs: Más de 3.5 millones de luces, túneles brillantes, un laberinto de luz y un carrusel.

items.name: Christmas Around the World
items.venue: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
items.addr: 5700 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60637
items.blurb: A four-story Grand Tree surrounded by trees decorated for holiday traditions from around the world.
items.blurbEs: Un gran árbol de cuatro pisos rodeado de árboles decorados según tradiciones de todo el mundo.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in Chicago: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Christkindlmarket Chicago
items.dates: Nov 20 – Dec 24; Fri–Sat 11 AM–9 PM, Sun–Thu to 8 PM
items.blurb: The 30th year of Chicago's German-style market: ornaments, mulled wine in souvenir mugs and bratwurst.
items.blurbEs: El año 30 del mercado alemán de Chicago: adornos, vino caliente en tazas de recuerdo y salchichas.

items.name: Christkindlmarket Wrigleyville
items.dates: Nov 20 – Dec 31; Mon–Thu 3–9 PM, Fri–Sat 11 AM–9 PM, Sun to 7 PM
items.blurb: The market's second Chicago location, right outside Wrigley Field. Open through New Year's Eve.
items.blurbEs: La segunda sede del mercado, junto a Wrigley Field. Abierto hasta Nochevieja.

items.name: Christkindlmarket Aurora
items.blurb: A riverside suburban edition of the market, open Thursday through Sunday.
items.blurbEs: Una versión del mercado junto al río, abierta de jueves a domingo.
